standalone.brief: Write the go-release skill (directory skills/go-release/: SKILL.md plus references/ as needed). It is the procedure the map's Artifact set decision and the authoring notes name for cutting a Go release: tag and version decisions (module tags, /vN, retract on a mistake, gorelease or apidiff for libraries), goreleaser v2 check and snapshot, the double-build reproducibility check, version stamping, raw per-platform assets named for mirror consumers plus checksums, signing and provenance, and verification of the published assets. Frontmatter exactly like skills/jvm-release/SKILL.md (name, description with a Use when clause and a Not for clause, license, metadata summary and keywords). The skill is procedure only; it cites GO-REL and GO-MOD rule IDs and never redefines them; any MUST row it duplicates lives in a | # | Finding | Rule | table with the ID last. Mark pinned defaults (owner decisions in go-frame.md) as pinned. Every command in it follows the verification-command shape rules and names the tool version.

Write the go-upgrade skill (directory skills/go-upgrade/: SKILL.md plus references/ as needed). It is the procedure for moving a module to a new Go release or triaging a dependency: read the release notes and the GODEBUG diff, bump the go and toolchain lines per the policy, run go fix and review its diff, stdversion, bump the golangci-lint pin and config, audit GOEXPERIMENT pins, govulncheck reachability triage (text-mode exit code), replace superseded modules, and re-run the gate. Frontmatter exactly like skills/jvm-release/SKILL.md. Procedure only; cites GO-LANG, GO-MOD and GO-GATE IDs, never redefines them; duplicated MUST rows go in a | # | Finding | Rule | table with the ID last. Every command follows the verification-command shape rules and names the tool version.

Write the go-diagnose skill (directory skills/go-diagnose/: SKILL.md plus references/ as needed). It is the symptom-routed runbook for a hung, leaking, racy or slow Go process: goroutine dumps (SIGQUIT, GOTRACEBACK), the goroutine leak profile where the release has it, pprof (CPU, heap, allocs, block, mutex), the execution tracer and flight recorder, -race reproduction, GODEBUG knobs, and benchmark evidence with benchstat before any performance claim. Route by symptom like skills/bazel-diagnose/SKILL.md does. Frontmatter exactly like skills/jvm-release/SKILL.md. Procedure only; cites GO-OBS, GO-CONC, GO-IO and GO-TEST IDs, never redefines them. Every command follows the verification-command shape rules and names the Go version.
